title: One chachma from the Essence to the hand: the particular united with the whole
overview:
What was shown of the will, chapter 8 shows of *chachma*, the *middos*, thought, speech and action. One *chachma* creates, forms and makes. It comes down through cause and effect, world by world, but the *memutzaim* (intermediaries) "don't really count", as the *chachma* in Betzalel's hands is the *chachma* in his brain. That is why the doing proves the *chachma*: the prototype that blows up shows the flaw in the concept, and a financial genius should be rich. Shlomo's wisdom, the Holy of Holies and the *chesed* we ask for all come from the Essence itself, and for Him there is no difference between first and last, as for Michelangelo the worm is no less than the king.

The second class takes it into the physical world. Whatever happens is *mamash* the *Aibershter* doing it, as a murder is blamed on the man and not the knife, though a person, unlike a knife, can choose not to be the instrument. The contemplation ends in a *kitzur muflag*, the child's "he hit me": *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof* is *Malchus* of *Asiya*, "I have not changed."

sections.title: Chachma, like the will, comes down from the Essence through every world (not read in class)
sections.summary: As with *Keser* and the simple will, *chachma* too is contracted from the Essence and drawn down through every world to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*: "You made them all with wisdom." The recorded class begins after these lines.

sections.title: One chachma creates, forms and makes: the proof is in the doing
sections.summary: The *chachma* that comes down from *Beriya* to *Yetzira* to *Asiya* is one and the same *chachma*, as the plans and the factory are one *chachma* of the airplane. That is why the doing is what proves the *chachma*, and why the intermediaries between the brain and the hands "don't really count".

phrases.he: כי כמו שכתוב בראשית, בחכמתא ברא,
כך בחכמה יצר ועשה
כמו ברצון, שברא ויצר ועשה הכל ברצון אחד
רק שנשתלשל וירד מעולם הבריאה לעולם היצירה
ומעולם היצירה לעשיה בירידת מדריגות עילה ועלול
כמו ממלכות דכתר דבריאה נעשה כתר ליצירה כו'
כך בחכמה אחד ברא ויצר ועשה
רק שירד ונשתלשל מבריאה ליצירה כו'
דהיינו שנמשך מבחינת מלכות שבחכמה דבריאה לחכמה שבמלכות דיצירה
phrases.en: *Malchus* of *chachma* becomes *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Yetzira*.

blocks.text: Just as He created, formed and made everything with one will, so He created, formed and made with one *chachma*. It only comes down through a *hishtalshelus* (chain of descent) from *Beriya* to *Yetzira* to *Asiya*, level by level, by cause and effect: as *Malchus* of *Keser* of *Beriya* becomes *Keser* of *Yetzira*. And yet it is one *chachma*.

blocks.title: The airplane prototype that blows up
blocks.text:
Take the *sechel* (intellect), say the *sechel* for building airplanes: in it there are different levels. First there is the *etzem* of the *sechel*, the concept itself, which brings the idea into being from nothing. That goes into the *bina* of the actual intellectual study of all the different things, aerodynamics and whatever. Through a *hishtalshelus* it goes into a *Yetzira*, until you can actually sit and make plans for an airplane, and all the way down to the actual *chachma* of making the airplane in the factory. And it is *mamash* the same *chachma*.

The proof: if you cannot make the actual airplane, there is a flaw in your original *chachma* of *Atzilus*. "Let's go back to the planning board," as they say. They made a whole *chachma*; it went from the *Atzilus* of the original concept through *Beriya* and *Yetzira*, where they made the plans, and finally they made a prototype. The prototype goes up in the air and blows up. The wings come off from the air pressure, or whatever.

So what does it mean? The *chachma* of *Asiya* did not work, and that shows on the *chachma* of *Atzilus*, because it is the same *chachma*. They are not different *chachmos*. It is really all one *chachma*, even though there is a *hishtalshelus*.

blocks.title: The scientific method
blocks.text: This, by the way, is the whole thing of the scientific method. It starts with pure abstract concepts, like gravity, and then you finally have to put it into a laboratory experiment, where you can apply it in *Asiya*. If the application in *Asiya* does not work, that proves the original concept, the original theory, was wrong. The theory is actually in *bina*: it is a *sevara* (a line of reasoning), already the world of *Beriya*. But if the *sevara* of *Beriya* did not work, it means the original concept in *chachma* was wrong too. We made it according to the hypothesis and the theory we put together from the *chachma*, and the *Asiya* did not work: so the original thing was wrong. It means that all the *chachmos* are one and the same.

it is drawn from *Malchus* of *chachma* of *Beriya* to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Yetzira*, and in the middle there are a whole bunch more levels: from *Malchus* of *chachma* of *Beriya* to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Beriya*, down to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Malchus*, which becomes *chachma* of *Keser* of *Yetzira*, and all the way down, finally, to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Yetzira*.

phrases.he: ועל דרך זה מיצירה לעשיה
עד חכמה שבמלכות דעשיה
phrases.en: the *chachma* of the actual making of the thing.

phrases.he: שעל זה אמר כולם בחכמה עשית,
phrases.en: You made them all with a *chachma*.

phrases.he: וכן יהו״ה בחכמה יסד ארץ
phrases.en: With *chachma* He actually made this actual earth.

phrases.he: וכהאי גוונא

blocks.text: down to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*: the *chachma* of the actual making of the thing. Of this it says **"You made them all with a *chachma*."**

blocks.title: The financial genius who is not rich
blocks.text: Say this guy is a financial genius. So: if he is such a big financial genius, how come he is not rich? What kind of financial genius is that? You expect a financial genius to be a rich guy. In any kind of *chachma* you expect that it should come out, that you should be able to do it. It is *davka* the *Asiya* of the thing that proves the *chachma*.

blocks.title: Napoleon and the war-game simulator
blocks.text: Or say this guy is a genius in war tactics, like Napoleon. How do you know Napoleon was a genius in war tactics? Look at what he did. Now, not everybody has the opportunity to apply his genius in war tactics. Fine, but at least he should be able to do it in a game, on a computer. If they tell the army, "This guy is a genius in war tactics, why don't you use him?", how are they going to test him? *Davka* through *Asiya*: they put him on one of these war-game simulators, to see if he can win. The same with a genius in chess, or whatever the thing: the *Asiya* and the genius are all one *chachma*.
"*Havaya* with *chachma* founded the earth": with *chachma* He actually made this actual earth. That means the whole *chachma* of how plants work, how animals work and how everything is put together.

phrases.he: (והגם שדרך פרט הרי משתלשל מבחינת מלכות דמלכות דבריאה להיות כתר ליצירה
phrases.en: Really it goes from *chachma* of *Beriya*, is *mishtalshel* to *Malchus* of *Beriya*, and from *Malchus* of *Beriya* it's *mishtalshel* to become *Keser* of *Yetzira*.

phrases.he: והחכמה דיצירה ממלכות דכתר דיצירה,
phrases.en: And then the *chachma* of *Yetzira* comes from *Malchus* of *Keser* of *Yetzira*.

phrases.he: מכל מקום
phrases.en: But nonetheless,

phrases.he: דרך כלל כל בחינת עילה ועלול מעולם לעולם
נמשך מזה לזה שלא על ידי צמצום רבוי הממוצעים שביניהם
phrases.en: it really comes without *hishtalshelus*; the *memutzaim* don't really count.

blocks.text: In the particular way, the *chachma* of *Beriya* comes down to *Malchus* of *Beriya*, and *Malchus* of *Beriya* comes down to become *Keser* of *Yetzira*; then the *chachma* of *Yetzira* comes from *Malchus* of *Keser* of *Yetzira*. nevertheless, in the general way, from world to world, it is drawn not through the contraction of the many *memutzaim* (intermediaries) between them.

blocks.title: The chachma in Betzalel's hands
blocks.text:
It says that Betzalel was a *chacham* (a wise man): he had the *chachma* of making artistic things. The *chachma* in his hands comes through the nerves and so on; that is really a whole *hishtalshelus*, though not to the point that you cannot call it *chachma*. But really it is not like that. It is *mamash* the *chachma* in his brain. When he is making the thing, it is the *chachma* in his brain that is doing it. It is not a real *hishtalshelus*; it is coming down without *hishtalshelus*.

In the particular way it does have to come down step by step. If it does not go from the brain, from the inner brain to the outer brain, to the nerves, to this, to that, and finally into the hands, he will not be able to make it. But nonetheless it really comes without *hishtalshelus*. The *memutzaim* don't really count.

sections.title: Shlomo's wisdom and the Holy of Holies: all from the chachma of the Essence
sections.summary: The *chachma* G-d gave Shlomo came down through every level, from the *chachma* in the Essence to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, and so did the light of the Holy of Holies, which rested on a physical Ark. So we ask for *daas* "from You".

phrases.he: כמו ויהו״ה נתן חכמה לשלמה, שהיה בעולם העשיה
הרי נמשך השפעה זו מחכמה שבעצמיות אור אין סוף
לחכמה דאדם קדמון
ומחכמה דאדם קדמון לחכמה סתימאה דעתיק יומין ואריך אנפין
ומשם לאור אבא דאצילות
עד בחינת חכמה שבמלכות דאצילות
ומשם לחכמה שבמלכות דבריאה
וכן על דרך זה מבריאה ליצירה ומיצירה לעשיה,
עד שבא האור ושפע חכמה אלהי״ת הזאת בנשמת שלמה מחכמה שבמלכות דעשיה

blocks.text: "And *Havaya* gave *chachma* to Shlomo," who was in the world of *Asiya*. His wisdom came from the *chachma* in the Essence of the *Or Ein Sof*, through *Adam Kadmon*, *Atik* and *Arich*, *Abba* of *Atzilus*, and on down, world by world, to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, and from there into his soul. It is all *tzimtzum*. But the *chachma* nonetheless came from upstairs. It is all connected.

phrases.he: וכן בהיכל קדש הקדשים שבבית המקדש
האיר מכתר וחכמה שבעצמיות
עד בחינת כתר וחכמה שבהיכל קדש קדשים דעשיה
בלוחות וארון גשמיים שהיו עומדים בהיכל קדש קדשים הבנוי למטה,
היה שורה מכתר וחכמה דהיכל קדש קדשים דעשיה הרוחניות כו'

blocks.text: Here he gives a slightly different *shita* (view) than the *Tanya*. In the *Tanya* it says that the Holy of Holies had its light directly from *Malchus* of *Atzilus* and *Beriya*, without being dressed in *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, with no *hishtalshelus* down to the spiritual *Asiya*. You could say that the *Tanya* is talking about the second Temple. But that will not work, because here he says in the physical Tablets and Ark, and those were only in the first Temple. So you have to say it is both ways: it really was without *hishtalshelus*, and yet it did come down into an actual physical Ark, which came out of *Malchus* of *Asiya*.

phrases.he: (וכך אנו מבקשים, אתה חונן לאדם דעת כו'
וחננו מאתך דוקא כו'
phrases.en: Give us *daas* from Your *daas*.

phrases.he: ודי למבין)

blocks.text: "grant us from You." Why would it say that? Why does it not say: give us *daas* from the *daas* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*? It says: give us *daas* from Your *daas*.

sections.title: In man too: one hischakmus from deep study to business, and no difference between first and last
sections.summary: The same mind that does pure analysis solves the problem at work and runs a business: it is all one *hischakmus*. Why the smart are not rich is a matter of *daas*. And as for the artist the worm is no less than the king, for Him there is no difference between first and last.

phrases.he: (ועל דרך משל הנה יובן באדם התחתון,
כמו שחכמתו העצמיות ההיולית
כולל כל הסתעפות התפשטות אור חכמתו,
עד לחוץ מעצמות שלו לגמרי
והוא עד שכל המלובש בעשיה גשמית,
phrases.en: Which is like when he's making an actual thing: the *sechel* is *mluvash* in the power of his hands.

phrases.he: נבדלת לגמרי
ואין הפרש אצלו בין התפשטות חכמתו העצמיות בעצם שכלו להשכיל עיון שכלי,
להתפשטות שלה בעשיה נבדלת

blocks.text: by way of analogy it is understood in man below. When a man is making something, it is really the *chachma* in his brain. It is the same as here: "dead dogs don't bark." Go and take his brain out of his head, and you will see that his hands will not be able to make that beautiful thing anymore.

down to the intellect dressed in physical action: when he is making an actual thing, the *sechel* is dressed in the power of his hands. But nonetheless there is no difference for him. The same brain is being used.

blocks.title: The problem at work
blocks.text: Right now we are doing an intellectual *iyun* that has nothing to do with any application whatsoever. Later, let's say, a problem comes up at work that you have to find a solution to, some physical thing you have to figure out. Anybody understands that it is not a different *sechel* now. It is the same *sechel* you are using now that you use over there too. A guy who can be smart in this kind of *iyun* is also going to be a smart guy at coming up with solutions to problems that need *sechel*. It is really the same *sechel*, whether it is an inner *iyun* or an external figuring out of a physical problem.

phrases.he: שהכל נקרא בשם התחכמות אחד,
phrases.en: It's all called "he's a smart guy."

phrases.he: אלא שזה ברוחניות ובעצמותו יותר,
phrases.en: So this one is more a *ruchnius* thing and more inside of himself.

phrases.he: ובעשיה בא בדבר נבדל
phrases.en: In *Asiya*, it comes into a separate thing.

phrases.he: עד שלגבי בחינת העצמות ממש הרי הכל רק התחכמות אחד,
phrases.en: As far as he's concerned, it's all one *hischakmus*.

phrases.he: רק שהולכת ומתפשטת מעיון שכלו למדותיו ולמחשבתו,
עד שעושה ממש בחכמתו זו
כמו בהתחכמות בעסק משא ומתן כו')
phrases.en: Like when he tries to be a smart guy with a business.

blocks.text: it is all called by the name of one *hischakmus*: it is all called "he's a smart guy." only this one is more spiritual and more inside himself, and in action it comes into a separate thing. As far as he himself is concerned, it is all one *hischakmus*, spreading from his mind to his *middos* and thought until he acts with it. as in being smart in business: when he tries to be a smart guy in business, it is really the same smartness.

blocks.question: As we said before, it is davka Napoleon who is a genius. So if we are such geniuses, and the same genius can be applied to money, why don't we have money? The same hischakmus we just used to figure out what nobody even thought to ask a question about should be able to figure out how to make a lot of money. Where is the problem?
blocks.text: "You know where it is?" "In the interest," a student says. It is in the *daas*. The *chachma* we have; the *daas* we don't have. We do not have the *daas* into that thing.

That is one thing. The other thing is that money has to do with an external *mazal* (fortune): luck. You can be a big *chacham*, and a guy can be a totally stupid guy and money will just come to him. That has to do with upstairs: in front of the *Aibershter*, he's a bigger *chacham* than you.

"I don't understand. You guys are so smart and you can't make money?" The reason is that we do not have the *daas*. People like that are not as smart as you, and yet they are making money, and they have the *hischakmus* for business. "Yeah, their *hischakmus* is not as big as our *hischakmus*, but because they have a bigger *daas* into it, their whole *hischakmus* goes in there." Whereas we cannot pay attention over there, because we are paying too much attention over here.

blocks.title: The absent-minded professor
blocks.text: It is like the absent-minded professor. If there is too much *hischakmus*, if the guy is real smart, it goes *davka* to the higher things rather than the lower things, and he will not have time to bother himself with them: an Einstein type of guy. It seems like he does not have the wisdom even to get dressed properly. "What, are you stupid? You're getting dressed like that? You've got two different color shoes on." It is because it affects the *daas*. That is the problem.

That is also so with women, by the way. The reason women have less *daas* is not really that they are stupider; it is that they are smarter. They have a *bina yeseira* (an extra measure of *bina*), and that is why they have less *daas*: it affects the *daas*. They always think of another detail. They cannot concentrate as well as a man, because they are always thinking of another detail.

sensitivity.reason: A generalisation that women have less daas and cannot concentrate as well as a man.
sensitivity.publishable: It is the same with anyone who has a *bina yeseira* (an extra measure of *bina*): it is not that he is less smart, it is that he is smarter. He always thinks of another detail, and so it is harder for him to concentrate on one thing. Too much affects the *daas*.

phrases.he: וכמו ויאמר אלהי״ם יהי אור שבדיבור,
ובא לידי מעשה כמו שכתוב ויהי אור
הרי התחלתו מבחינת חכמתו העצמית שבעצמיות המאציל
שהאציל האור ואחר כך ברא ויצר ועשה כו'
וכך הוא בכל פרטי התהוות הנאצלים והנבראים והנוצרים והמעשים מעצמות האין סוף כו'
כולם מיוחדים ומקושרים כל פרטיהם בעצמיות אור אין סוף שבאבי''ע

blocks.text: "Let there be light," and "there was light": the speech came into action, and its beginning is from His essential *chachma* in the very Essence of the Emanator. (In the reading he notices that a *vav* is missing in his copy here.) And the same as with will and *chachma*, it is the same with all the *middos*: they are all united and bound with the Essence.

phrases.he: ואין הפרש לגבי עצמו בין ראשון לאחרון כלל
phrases.en: As far as He's concerned... by Him it makes no difference, an angel or a worm.

phrases.he: ואם כן מה שכתוב אני ראשון ואני אחרון
קאי גם בבחינת החכמה שבראש האצילות עד חכמה שבסוף העשיה כו'

blocks.text: there is no difference as far as He is concerned between first and last at all. By Him it makes no difference: an angel or a worm, the same thing.

blocks.title: Michelangelo's battle scene
blocks.text: What do you mean, no difference between an angel and a worm? Look at a great artist, like Michelangelo. He is making a battle scene, and in the battle scene there is the king, and there is a horse, and over there at the end of the scene there is a dead body with worms crawling on it. As far as the artist is concerned, the king is not more and the worm is not less. The same *chachma* and artistry, the same sense of beauty and of ratio, the same feeling for the emotion of the thing, the same catching of the *etzem* of the thing that he had in drawing the king, he had in drawing the worm. To him it is not a different thing.

blocks.title: The worms were harder
blocks.text: You say to him: "Wow, it must have been so hard for you to make the king. If you made just worms it would be easier." And he tells you: "No, actually, to tell you the truth, the worms were harder. The king is big and the worms are small, and to get the detail I got over there in the worms... If you understood artistry you would realize it was a bigger *chachma* to make the worm than to make the king. You see, the worms are in the background, and look at the fine detail: you can *mamash* see every detail of the worm. The king is in the forefront, a bigger picture, and he was real easy to do, actually. *Davka* the worm was hard to do." By the artist it is all the same thing.

Or the clouds, or the little flower there being crushed by the horse. As far as he is concerned it is all the same thing: "By me, to make the worm and to make the king is exactly the same thing." So there is no difference as far as He is concerned between first and last at all, and "I am first and I am last" applies also to the *chachma* at the head of *Atzilus* down to the *chachma* at the end of *Asiya*.

sections.title: The same in the middos, thought, speech and action: really only ten sefiros
sections.summary: As with will and *chachma*, the *middos* of each world are dressed in those of the next, down to the six extremities of *Asiya*, and the *chesed* we ask for here is the *chesed* of the *Ein Sof* itself. Thought, speech and action are the same: all one, and really there are only ten *sefiros*.

phrases.he: וכן יובן על דרך זה
phrases.en: And in the same way this is understood

phrases.he: דרך פרט בחינת יחוד כללי
בבחינת המדות ומחשבה דבור ומעשה
phrases.en: and the same applies to any of the *middos* and even the *levushim*, *machshava*, *dibur* and *maaseh*,

phrases.he: שבכל עולם מד' עולמות דאבי''ע
שמדות דאצילות מתלבשים במדות דבריאה
ומדות דבריאה במדות דיצירה ומדות דיצירה במדות דעשיה,
עד שבחינת ו׳ קצוות דעשיה נעוץ בתחלת הכל,
במדותיו העצמיים שלפני האצילות
שעל זה אמר המתנשא מימות עולם כידוע
והם בחינת ז׳ תחתונים דעתיק יומין
phrases.en: the seven *middos* of *Atik*,

phrases.he: עד ז׳ תחתונים דאדם קדמון
עד מדות שבאור אין סוף עצמו הגנוזות בעצמות שלו ממש

blocks.text: **And in the same way** it is understood with the *middos*, and even with the garments, thought, speech and action, in each of the four worlds. The *middos* of *Atzilus* are dressed in those of *Beriya*, and so on down, until the lowest extremity of *Asiya* is wedged into the beginning of all, in His essential *middos* before *Atzilus*: in the actual, as we said, self-*chesed*. These are the seven lower [*sefiros*] of *Atik Yomin*, the seven *middos* of *Atik*, up to the seven of *Adam Kadmon*, up to the *middos* hidden in the Essence itself.

phrases.he: כמו בחינת חסד שבאור אין סוף עצמו,
שעל זה אמר חסדי יהו״ה כי לא תמנו כו'
phrases.en: It's the *chesed* of the *Aibershter*, that He had mercy on us down here in physical.

phrases.he: בבחינת אין סוף ממש
אנו אומרים יהי חסדך זה עלינו ממש
phrases.en: Your *chesed* should be on us,

phrases.he: בבחינת חסד מצומצם שבמדות דמלכות דמלכות דעשיה שמאיר בעולם הזה כו'
phrases.en: to give us actual help.

blocks.text: "The kindnesses of *Havaya*, that we have not been consumed": it is the *chesed* of the *Aibershter*, that He had mercy on us down here in the physical, and it is the *Ein Sof* itself. And we say "May this kindness of Yours be upon us": Your *chesed* should be on us, as a contracted *chesed* of *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, which shines in this world, to give us actual help.

phrases.he: וכן מבחינת מחשבה שבעצמותו נמשך עד בחינת מחשבה דמלכות דעשיה, אשר חושב לעשות בפועל ממש
phrases.en: From His *machshava* in *Atzmus* it goes all the way to the thought to do something in actuality.

phrases.he: וכן בדבור ומעשה כו',
phrases.en: And this is all even in *dibur* and *maaseh*.

phrases.he: כי כמו שכל אשר חפץ ברצון העצמות עושה,
כך כל אשר חפץ ברצונו העצמי חושב כו'
רק שיורד ונמשך בהשתלשלות עד חפצו ורצונו ושכלו ומחשבתו בעשיה בפועל ממש כו'
אבל הכל רק רצון ושכל ומדה ומחשבה ומעשה אחד תחשב לגבי בחינת העצמות ממש, כמובן מכל הנ"ל וד"ל.

blocks.text: From His thought in the *Atzmus* (the Essence) it goes all the way down to the thought of doing something in actuality. So too in speech and action: even in speech and action, it comes from His inner power of speech and action. It comes down through the *hishtalshelus*, but it is all reckoned as one will, intellect, *midda*, thought and action as far as the Essence itself is concerned.

The basic thing is what it says, "ten *sefiros*, ten and not eleven, ten and not nine" (that is in *Sefer Yetzira*, a student puts in; he does not remember where he read the explanation of it). It means there really are only ten *sefiros*. It is not a hundred *sefiros*. The *chachma* of *chesed* is really in the brain. *Chachma* of *Asiya* and *chachma* of *Beriya* are not two different *chachmos*: there are really only ten *sefiros*, the ten *sefiros* of the *Aibershter*.

And those ten *sefiros* are the same *sefiros* on every level. It is not that there are ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* and ten of *Beriya* and so on, which is already forty, and each of those has ten, which is already four hundred. It is really not like that. There are actually ten *sefiros*, that's all there is. It breaks down as they come down, but it is really just ten.

sections.title: Even the physical is one chain: they blame the man, not the knife
sections.summary: Every physical particular is bound like a chain to the first source, so whatever is done below is *mamash* done by the *Aibershter* Himself, as a murder is blamed on the man and not on the knife. A person, unlike a knife, has a choice whether to be the instrument.

phrases.he: ואחכ"ז הרי ישכיל האדם בהתבוננותו במי ברא אלה בגשמיות,
איך שלא נבדל גם הפרט היותר אחרון מהמקור הכללי היותר ראשון
גם בכל פרט שבכל דבר ודבר כמו בבריאת שמים או ארץ או כל פרטי חלקי דומם צומח חי ומדבר
איך ששרשם ברוחניות דמלכות דעשיה עד רום המעלות
אחוז וקשור כשלשלת כו'
phrases.en: totally connected.

blocks.text: how even the very last particular is not separate from the very first general source … held and bound like a chain: totally connected. He said that the *chachma* of Shlomo was connected, even though it is very contracted. But it is not only by Shlomo; it is by everybody. It is the *Aibershter*'s *chachma* that he is using, because there is only one *chachma*. What he said at the top of the page about business is also coming from this *chachma*.

blocks.title: "You told him to curse me"
blocks.text: That is what it says: Naval cursed David HaMelech, and David says to the *Aibershter*, "You told him to curse me." This is explained in the *Tanya*, basically.

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב בראשית ברא, בקדמין ובחוכמתא כו'
הרי בחינת כתר וחכמה שבאבי''ע מיוחדים
כך כל פרטיהם המסתעפים מהם במדות ובמחשבה דבור ומעשה שבכל עולם
(שהוא כללות עשר ספירות דכל עולם שהוא עתיק יומין ואריך אנפין ואבא ואימא וזעיר אנפין ונוקבא דאבי״ע(
עד בחינת עשיה דמלכות דעשיה,
נעוץ סופן בתחלת הכל
דכמו שבקדמון האציל כו'
כך בקדמון זה עצמו ברא ויצר ועשה,
כמו שכתוב כל אשר חפץ כו'
phrases.en: Everything that He's *chafetz*.

blocks.text: Keser and chachma in Atzilus, Beriya, Yetzira and Asiya are united, and so are all their particulars, in the *middos*, thought, speech and action, the whole ten *sefiros* of each world, down to the action of *Malchus* of *Asiya*: their end is wedged into the beginning of all. With the same *Kadmon* with which He emanated, He created, formed and made.

We understand it the same way by a person. The *ratzon* (will) that moves his hand is not different from the *ratzon* that wants the thing itself, and that is not different from what he himself actually wants, the *ratzon* of the *etzem*. If he does something with his hand, it goes on his *etzem*.

blocks.title: They don't blame the bullet
blocks.text: The proof of it is the death penalty. They don't blame the hand; they blame him. And not only do they not blame the hand: they don't blame the bullet.

Like the thing with O.J. Simpson. You noticed one thing: it would have been a perfect defense. He could have said, "I didn't do it, it's obvious that a knife did it." "You don't know who did it, but actually a person didn't do it. It was a knife that did it."

sensitivity.reason: A joke that treats O.J. Simpson, by name, as the killer in the murders he was acquitted of.
sensitivity.publishable: A murderer would have a perfect defense: "I didn't do it, it's obvious that a knife did it. You don't know who did it, but actually a person didn't do it. It was a knife that did it."

blocks.text: So too here, even though it is like a knife. The world of *Atzilus* is still considered the *gufa d'malka* (the body of the King), but the worlds of *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* are already considered like external instruments: they are *levushim* (garments). And the *kelipos* (husks, the unholy) are certainly considered *mamash* separate, not even *levushim*.

blocks.title: Mordechai appealed to the wielder of the knife
blocks.text: And yet even by Haman it does not matter. As you see in the Megillah, the decree was from the *Aibershter*. Therefore, to get rid of the decree, Mordechai did not bow down to Haman. Instead he got the 22,000 children "and all that business", and he got all the Jews to fast. They appealed to the wielder of the knife, not to the knife. Whatever happens, it is *mamash* the *Aibershter* Himself who did it. Personally.

blocks.question: On the other hand, Haman was punished. That is what the Rambam says, and it is what Hillel says: "because you drowned others, you were drowned." But why? If the Aibershter did it, what does that mean?
blocks.text: The answer is from Nevuzaradan (or Neron: the class sorts that out next), who was told, "Wipe your hands on somebody else." He chose to be the instrument for it. As it says, *harbeh shluchim lamakom*: the Omnipresent has many messengers.

blocks.title: Neron and Nevuzaradan
blocks.text: Who said "Wipe your hands on someone else"? The class sorts it out. Rabbi Markel first says Nevuzaradan, then Neron, "I think, Neron Kesar." A student: not Nevuzaradan? No: Nevuzaradan actually killed them, a million people, but finally he converted; it is a story in the Gemara. He said, "Look at what the punishment is for one person," and that is the story with Zecharia's grave. The one who took an arrow and shot it, and said "wipe your hands", is Neron.

Whoever it was, the basic thing is that even though he is the instrument, he is unlike a knife. A knife is totally blameless; a person has choice. You cannot say, "This is a bad knife because it killed people." The knife can say back to you: "You know, I had no choice in the matter. I was just used, without any choice at all."

When you come to a dog, the dog can say, "I was trained this way." And really a dog is basically not punished, but he is still destroyed. It also says about the Egyptians that they were not punished for having enslaved the Jews; they were punished for delighting in it.

The basic thing is that a person does not have to go along with what the *Aibershter* is using him as an instrument for. He can change himself to be an instrument for something else, and the *Aibershter* will figure out already how to do it. Like with Neron: the *Aibershter* figured out how to destroy Jerusalem, but he was not part of it. Actually, he converted too.

He goes back to the text: down to the action of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, just as with the *Kadmon*, the Essence, so with this same *Kadmon* itself He created, formed and made, as it is written, "All that He desired." *Chafetz* (desired) is as in *chafetz chesed*: it means in the *Atzmus*, all the way down to *Malchus* of *Atzilus*, and really all the way down to actual *Asiya*. *Malchus* of *Atzilus* is like going from the brain to the hand, and *Malchus* of *Asiya* is going from the hand to the external utensil.

sections.title: The middos and His place: the particular united with the whole, as you blame the man and not his hand
sections.summary: Every emotion in every world has its place and existence from Him, up to "His place", the Essence that holds all worlds. The whole point of the contemplation is to see that it is *mamash* the *Aibershter* doing everything, as plainly as one knows that a punch came from the man and not from his hand.

phrases.he: וכך במדות,
phrases.en: It's the same thing like in the *ratzon*; the same thing is the *middos*.

phrases.he: כמו הנה מקום אתי,
phrases.en: There is a place with me.

phrases.he: בחי' ביטול הו׳ קצוות
לך יהו״ה הגדולה, בכל עולם
לפי מה שהוא
phrases.en: According to this world.

blocks.text: And so in the *middos*: the same as in the *ratzon*. **"There is a place with me."** "Yours, *Havaya*, is the greatness," in every world: as we said about the place, the only way you can have an emotion is *Lecha Havaya*, Yours. It does not mean only the greatness of *Atzilus*, or the Essence. It means that even the emotion you have, of *chesed* or *gevura*, the place for it and what gives it existence is still the *Aibershter*, in every world, all the way down to the *kelipos*: according to what it is, according to this world.

phrases.he: עד בחינת מקום העצמי שנקרא מקומו,
phrases.en: All the way to the *makom ha'atzmi*, which is His place.

phrases.he: וכמאמר רבותינו זכרונם לברכה הוא מקומו של עולם
ואין העולם מקומו
וכן מאמר הידוע דאיהו תפיס בכל עלמין
phrases.en: He holds on to all the worlds,

phrases.he: ולית מאן דתפיס ביה,
אפילו מחשבה ורצון הקדום כו'
phrases.en: even the *machshava kduma*.

blocks.text: up to the essential place, which is called "His place": *Mekomo*, the place of the *Aibershter*, which is the real *Atzmus*. (A student: that is "Blessed be the glory of *Havaya* from His place". From His own place.) He holds all the worlds, and there is none who holds Him, not even the *machshava kduma* (the primordial thought), which is the *tehiru tata'a*.

phrases.he: ומכל זה הרי יובן בחינת יחוד וחיבור הפרט אל הכלל דרך כללות הכל מעצמיות אור אין סוף באבי''ע
phrases.en: So from this, you understand that it's a direct connection all the way to the *Aibershter*.

phrases.he: מלבד בחינת היחוד שבכל עולם דרך פרט,
בעשר ספירות שבו כו'
phrases.en: by the *sefiros*, so to speak.

blocks.text: From this you understand that it is a direct connection all the way to the *Aibershter*. And that is the main thing of the whole *hisbonenus* (contemplation): to understand that it is *mamash* the *Aibershter* doing the whole thing. It is not just the *pratim* (particulars).

blocks.title: The creature from another dimension
blocks.text: The thing is the connection of all the *pratim* together, to see it instantly. Take the knife. Say someone has no idea at all how a person or the world works, some weird creature from another dimension. He says: "How come he didn't say the knife did it?" We say: "Because the knife is connected to the hand." "Oh, so how come you didn't say the hand did it, and they should cut off his hand?" "Because the hand is connected to the heart, and the heart is connected to the head, and the head is connected to the *ratzon*, which is connected to himself, to his soul. That's why, if we find that the knife did it, it means he did it, and we can kill him."

blocks.title: "I'm mad at your hand"
blocks.text: But a person who knows all this does not have to think about the whole *hishtalshelus*, because he knows it. It is obvious. If somebody punches you, you don't say, "Hey, I'm mad at your hand." No: "I'm mad at you." Why? Because you understand the whole *hishtalshelus*, how the nerves work and how the muscles go, and that it all came from the head and the heart, which came from the actual *ratzon* of the person himself.

By the *Aibershter* it is not so easy to see, and that is what the *hisbonenus* is for. Once you have done the *hisbonenus* properly, you go back to the *daas* of a small child. A small child thinks the *Aibershter* is here, invisible. And the Mitteler Rebbe said that this is so close to the truth that it is really the truth. That is how it is: it is *mamash* the *Aibershter* here doing these things.

Once you understand the *hishtalshelus*, you blame everything on the *Aibershter*. If it is a good thing, you say it is the *Aibershter*; if it is a bad thing, you also blame the *Aibershter*. Except for one thing: it says that from the *Aibershter* only good comes. "All that the Merciful One does, He does for good." That is also explained in the *Tanya*: there is good from the *alma d'isgalya* (the revealed world) and good from the *alma d'iskasya* (the hidden world), and when the good is hidden it is actually a bigger good. The curses in the Torah are actually the bigger blessings.

When we went into exile, this exile is really the *alma d'iskasya* of Moshiach. And what he says there is that when you realize this, it will change, so that the good comes as big as it was in the *alma d'isgalya*: from the *alma d'iskasya* it will come into the *alma d'isgalya*.

So once you know the *hishtalshelus*, you don't need the *hishtalshelus* anymore. A person does not have to think, "His hand was connected to his arm, and his arm to his heart, and his heart to his brain." He does not think that. He just thinks, "He hit me." Instantly. Like *ani ani hu*, I, I am He: him in his head is him in his hand. Or even if he threw a stone: you don't say, "The stone is a separate thing, and the stone hit me." You don't say that. It is still the *koach hapoel bapeula* (the power of the maker in the deed).

the unification and joining of the particular with the whole means to connect all the way from the stone to the self, in the general way of the whole, to the *Aibershter* Himself. besides the unification in each world in the particular way, in the *sefiros*, so to speak: to realize that the ten *sefiros* of the heart are connected to the ten *sefiros* of the brain, and the *chachma* in the hand is connected to the *chachma* in the head.

blocks.title: The smart pen
blocks.text: You don't say, "He has a smart hand." Look, this guy wrote such a smart scientific paper, he must have a smart hand? What do you mean, he has a smart hand? "What, are you stupid? It's not a smart hand, he has a smart pen! If I could get a pen like that, then I could also be smart."

sections.title: Kitzur muflag: once you know the chain, it is one shot, and "I have not changed"
sections.summary: One who knows the whole chain in detail should still draw his soul to the general unity, until it all comes to him in a *kitzur muflag*, as a child knows his brother hit him. Then *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof* is *Malchus* of *Asiya* in one shot: "I, *Havaya*, have not changed," and His kingship is as strong at the border as in the capital.

phrases.he: אך אף על פי שיודע האדם כל ביאור ההשתלשלות דאבי''ע בפרט,
ימשוך נפשו ליחוד הפרט אל היחוד בכלל,
עד עצמיות אור אין סוף ממש על דרך הנזכר לעיל וכהאי גוונא
מלבד היחוד וביטול כל עולם בפרט לגבי העצמות כו'
phrases.en: Beside the *yichud* of every particular world,

phrases.he: עד שיבוא לו כל ההתבוננות שמרחיב בפרט בענין זה, בקיצור מופלג
phrases.en: until finally, once he really knows his *hisbonenus*, the whole thing will come to him with a *kitzur muflag*.

blocks.text: he should draw his soul to the unification of the particular with the general unification. Really, what he is saying is that you only have to try to do this when you are starting. If you really know the *seder hishtalshelus*, it becomes totally obvious to you. You don't have to figure out that when a person threw a stone at you it was him who threw it. You don't say, "Let me make the *yichudim* here: the stone came from the hand..." You don't have to do that. It is automatic, one shot.

besides the unification and *bittul* of each world in particular: besides the unity of every particular world. It is the same as the heart: if he had a feeling in his heart, you know that he had the feeling, and if he had a thought in his brain, you know that he had the thought.

blocks.title: "He hit me"
blocks.text: until all the contemplation … comes to him in a *kitzur muflag*. As said at the beginning, he will have to try; but once he really knows his *hisbonenus*, the whole thing will come to him in a *kitzur muflag*: "He hit me." Even a little kid knows that. A little kid comes and says his brother hit him. He doesn't say "his hand hit me"; he says "he hit me". That is a *kitzur muflag*: *ani ani hu*.

phrases.he: כמו מלכותך מלכות כל עולמים
שזהו בחינת מלכות דאין סוף במלכות דמלכות דעשיה
על דרך הנזכר לעיל ברצון וחכמה ומדות כו'
כמו שכתוב ראו כי אני אני הוא ממש
phrases.en: I am the same one at the beginning and the end;

phrases.he: וכן אני יהו״ה לא שניתי
phrases.en: it's not a different *Aibershter* down here.

phrases.he: בחינת אני הוא בחינת מלכות, שהוא בחינת אין דכתר, דנעוץ תחלתן בסופן
phrases.en: The *ayin* of the *Keser* is right away in the *Malchus*.

phrases.he: בכל עולם בפרט וכן דרך כללות הכל
phrases.en: Besides the fact that it goes from the highest *Keser* to the lowest *Malchus*, in every world it is also like that.

blocks.text: "Your kingship is the kingship of all worlds": *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof* and *Malchus* of *Asiya*, one shot. "See now that I, I am He": I am the same one at the beginning and at the end. "I, *Havaya*, have not changed": it is not a different *Aibershter* down here.

in each world in particular: in each world it is also like that, and that is why it says *Keser Malchus*. The *ayin* of the *Keser* is right away in the *Malchus*. Besides its going from the highest *Keser* to the lowest *Malchus*, in every world it is like that too. *Keser Malchus*: what happened to the *sefiros* in the middle? It is as if they don't exist. He wanted it, and He did it.

phrases.he: ולזה אומר אני יהו״ה לא שניתי,
בין מלכות דאין סוף למלכות דעשיה, כלל
phrases.en: No difference: the same *Aibershter*.

phrases.he: וזה שכתוב מלכותך הוא מלכות כל עולמים
phrases.en: Your *Malchus* is the *Malchus* of all the worlds,

phrases.he: עד מלכות דמלכות דעשיה,
מטעם כל הנזכר לעיל ודי למבין:

blocks.text: "I, *Havaya*, have not changed" between *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof* and *Malchus* of *Asiya*, not at all: no difference, the same *Aibershter*. "Your kingship is the kingship of all worlds": Your *Malchus* is the *Malchus* of all the worlds, "from Hodu to Kush".

blocks.title: From Shushan to the border
blocks.text: From Shushan the capital to the far extremities of the kingdom, it is all the same *Malchus*. Just because you go away from Shushan the capital, the *Malchus* does not get lessened at all. It is just as strong by the border as it is in the capital, and it is the same law everywhere: down to *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*.

reviewQuestions.question: What does the airplane prototype that blows up show about the *chachma* of *Atzilus* and the *chachma* of *Asiya*?
In what sense does the *chachma* in Betzalel's hands come "without *hishtalshelus*", if it has to pass through the nerves?
If the same *hischakmus* serves deep study and business, why are smart people not always rich?
How does Michelangelo's battle scene explain "there is no difference as far as He is concerned between first and last"?
If whatever happens is the *Aibershter* doing it, as a murder is blamed on the man and not the knife, why was Haman punished?
What is the *kitzur muflag*, and why does the little kid say "he hit me" and not "his hand hit me"?

notes.text: Lines 1-10 are not read in any class of the series: class 056 begins at line 11. Their phrases are a plain rendering, not his.
He says that Naval cursed David and David said "You told him to curse me". The curser in that verse is Shimi ben Gera (II Samuel 16:10-11); left as he said it.
He contrasts the text with "the Tanya" on the Holy of Holies but does not say where in the Tanya; left as he said it.
Class 056 has almost two minutes with no transcribed words between w3124 (24:57) and w3125 (26:47), in the reading of lines 43-44; the reading resumes mid-line. Possibly a pause in the tape.

The Neron/Nevuzaradan exchange is muddled in the recording (who said "wipe your hands on someone else", who converted).
